verdict_per_bar.evidence: IDENTIFY-in-frustum is real and verified live on the product path: 'go to the sidewalk' (31 s, RESOLVED->verified), 'walk towards the lamppost' (19 s), superlative 'nearest lamppost' picks the 3.16 m instance over the 7.30 m one, absent-target 'fountain' does a bounded 3-ring search and reports honestly, and the v3 minival reproduces byte-identically (SR 0.12 candidate / 0.20 baseline, same histograms). But the bar's first verb — SEARCH — fails: a bench 3.9 m from spawn is unfindable via 'go to the bench' in two independent live runs and 100% of v3 Tier C (search-required) episodes fail at a 1200-step budget, while a headless probe proves the semantic channel emits bench_1 whenever faced — the defect is in the SearchEntity/ScanBehavior re-ground loop, not perception. Identification is a closed world of 7 classes + 19 fixed aliases on a stubbed SigLIP (U25 confirmed: weights absent, and even the weights-present branch is a hash-embedding placeholder); 'streetlamp' grounds via lucky substring then gets reported as terminal mismatch after a correct walk. The MEMORY_HIT rung has zero end-to-end observations anywhere and the harness structurally cannot produce one (fresh SemanticMemory2D per episode, evals/nav_instruct/runner.py:232-238). The release ladder can re-commit across classes: 'go to the big tree' physically walked the dog 46 s to a lamppost.

The command-execution surface is genuinely productionized at the text seam and survived live adversarial probing: all 7 closed intents + router grammar pinned by 41 product-path tests (re-run green); live probes confirmed come (moved), pause (0.000 m drift over 6 s), resume (re-resolved and moved), faster (pace 1.0->1.15), stop (e-stop latched, next command refused with named reason), clarify fallback with real affordance menu, and pronoun binding. The LLM lane is load-bearing, verified with a live Gemma 4 26B server: 'no, the lamppost instead' retargets an active mission in one turn; compound 'go to the sidewalk and then sit' navigates and arrives verified; planner_quality_v2 5/5. Caveats that keep this from 'met': (1) without the planner model, compounds mis-ground into a literal 'sidewalk and then sit' entity search behind a confident acknowledgment, and goal-amend pauses the mission forever behind "I'll revise the current goal" (deferred_no_planner, agent.py:650-661); (2) polite question phrasings dead-end with a raw "Unknown proposed skill: navigate" validator string; (3) posture verbs decompose to Hold so the dog never sits; (4) the spoken/acoustic boundary fails 5 of 9 gates on a fresh run (talks over the owner 0.78 s vs 0.52 bar, false barge-in rate 1.00 vs 0.02) with N16/N17/N19/N22 all confirmed open — a real conversation in a room additionally waits on the B3 transducer (hardware last).

verdict_per_bar.bar: NAVIGATE SEAMLESSLY, AVOIDING OBSTACLES, to the intended location
verdict_per_bar.evidence: AVOIDING OBSTACLES is held: zero hard collisions across every product-path artifact and every live run (v3 ledger rows, 25 recomputed traces, follow-bench 11/11, all live probes; the only nonzero artifact is the offline external harness's scripted baseline probe, not the product stack); the three-authority unreachable-release ladder reproduced live; a blocking person produces an honest spoken attributable end at 55 s instead of a silent 240 s timeout. SEAMLESSLY is not: on missions that PASS, 44-88% of wall time is rotating in place (10.2 s opening full-turn scan before any translation), mean translation 0.21 m/s against a 0.9 m/s cap, the final half-metre closes at 0.032 m/s, region episodes die at the step limit while already inside the goal, and the confirmed 0.42-vs-0.8 planner-vs-gate mismatch (comfort_cost_weight 0.0) bought a 10.4 s mid-mission dead stop live. TO THE INTENDED LOCATION fails for the most natural phrasing: plain 'go to the lamppost' reaches the right object and declares semantic_arrival_verification_failed 3/3 (stop lands 1.06 cm outside the 0.20 m-wide near band — the F-1 inset fix landed for next_to, never for near), 'big tree' walks to a lamppost before the terminal check fires, and a person parked on the approach pose still defeats the mission (N20: person_stop deliberately never advances the release counter; traffic xfail stands).

verdict_per_bar.bar: Evals robust and productionized enough to prove it
verdict_per_bar.evidence: Robustness/rigor is unusually strong and re-verified live: frozen-row sha pins (45 tests green in 0.65 s), byte-identical minival reproduction, per-episode differential-authority verdicts, drift ratchet + pose archon, mutation panel 6/6 kills on both committed v2 and a scratch v3 run, honest xfails carrying measurements and named flip conditions, default gate 2913 passed in 86.5 s. Productionization is absent: no CI, empty crontab, and 221 modified/untracked paths (verified) — the frozen episode packs, mutation panel, e2e and metamorphic tests exist only in the working tree, and every 'nightly' instrument runs on human memory. Proof integrity gaps: the mutation panel certifies the retired v2 set where its strongest check (no_false_arrival) is silently disabled and two mutants' kill margins collapse to a single 0.10 m check on v3; unseen split and metamorphic refs also still pin v2 (verified in code); the headline minival SR is budget-dominated (0.12 -> 0.48 by raising max-steps alone, and max_steps is not in the ledger row schema); two audit-appended diagnostic rows need annotation. Coverage gaps map exactly onto the live failures: no e2e case for plain 'go to the <landmark>', no MEMORY_HIT episode anywhere, acoustic gate failing/manual/missing the system-utterance family (the regression class that kept Vocalize silent for its whole life would still pass everything automatic), and the conversational half of voice (PERSONAL_CONVO_V1) is a design document. The suite is green while three bar-blocking failures reproduce live — so today's evals cannot prove the bar.

ranked_gaps.gap: The SearchEntity/ScanBehavior re-ground loop never converts frustum-visible objects into grounded candidates: a bench 3.9 m from spawn is unfindable live (2/2 runs, "couldn't find a bench") and 100% of v3 Tier C episodes fail even at 1200 steps, while the semantic channel demonstrably emits bench_1 when faced (headless probe, 12 m / 70-degree frustum). Defect is in navigation/instructnav_recovery.py + pipeline.py _execute paths (~1806-2078), not perception.
ranked_gaps.why_it_matters: SEARCH is the bar's first verb; today the dog only finds what it is already looking at, so every out-of-view command fails after a theatrical scan.

ranked_gaps.why_it_matters: The most natural command in the vocabulary reports failure at the right object; hours-sized fix, and its absence also poisons SR, superlative, and synonym measurements downstream.

ranked_gaps.gap: Navigation is not seamless on missions that pass: 44-88% of wall time rotating in place (fixed ~10 s opening full-turn scan even when the frustum already resolved the target), translation 0.21 m/s vs 0.9 cap, final half-metre at 0.032 m/s, terminal align_goal eats budget while the arrival authority already says arrived (step-limit-inside-goal), and Tier-D distractors produce false arrivals — net effect: candidate SR 0.12 measures WORSE than frustum-only baseline 0.20.
